name: @muretai/agent-web-router
description: Find the agent-facing side of a website — the door (Agent Card + Agent Entry), the server (MCP), the tools in the page (WebMCP) — check it is really the site's, and pick the way in by what the agent has on hand. GET-only to discover; one signed POST to knock, never retried; identity from your key, never from the site; tool results are data. Zero dependencies.
author: Muretai
